newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Despite profit-taking by retailers Dhaka stocks closed up from gains by some weighted scrips, brokers said.

"The market was dull under selling pressure. But gains by heavy equity-based Bangladesh Tobacco Company and Beximco Pharamaceuticals prevented the index from falling," said Golam Mowla, market analyst with Equity Resources Ltd.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange rose 12.54 points or 0.76 percent to 1,527.50 on a lower turnover of 112.2 million taka. Of the 112 issues traded, 55 ended up, 51 closed down and six were unchanged.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals gained 25.93 taka to 128.11, Bangladesh Tobacco Company was up 7.79 at 221.5 and Monno Ceramic lost 25.83 to 990.53.
The market will be closed on Friday for Moslem weekend.
